summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Khurpi Microgreens order flow. Backend: 18/18 tests passed. Frontend: All critical flows verified. Order creation, user orders page, admin payments page all working correctly.

missing_features.issue: No /admin/orders page exists in frontend even though backend API /api/admin/orders is available
missing_features.note: Admin can view orders through Payments page which shows linked order info

action_items: Consider adding dedicated Admin Orders page at /admin/orders for better order management (optional enhancement)
critical_code_review_comments: Order creation API correctly validates user and address existence
Payment records are automatically created when orders are placed
Order status is correctly set to 'confirmed' when payment_status is 'paid'
Admin payments page shows linked order information
Checkout page correctly calculates delivery fee based on address coordinates
Razorpay integration is properly configured with real credentials
seed_data_creation: Test orders created via API during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order flow fully tested. Test order ID: 082badfb-42c8-45bc-bd40-01ad14d42e32. User has 3 one-time orders and 2 active subscriptions. Admin payments page shows all payments with linked order info. No dedicated admin orders page exists but payments page provides order visibility.

ORDER_CREATION_API.details: POST /api/orders creates order and payment records correctly. Status set to 'confirmed' when payment_status is 'paid'.

USER_ORDERS_PAGE.details: User can view all orders at /orders. Shows order details, product info, status, and address. Test order #082badfb visible with Turnip Microgreens × 2 for ₹360.

ADMIN_PAYMENTS_PAGE.details: Admin can view all payments at /admin/payments. Shows 3 payments totaling ₹720. Each payment shows user info, amount, status, and date.

CART_TO_CHECKOUT_FLOW.details: User can add products to cart, proceed to checkout, see delivery address, delivery fee calculation, and Razorpay payment options.

DELIVERY_FEE_CALCULATION.details: Delivery fee correctly calculated based on distance from shop. Free delivery for addresses within 1km.

USER_LOGIN.details: User can login with phone and password. Redirects to products page after successful login.

ADMIN_LOGIN.details: Admin can login with username/password. Redirects to dashboard after successful login.

mocked_apis_note: No mocked APIs - all operations use real backend endpoints with real Razorpay credentials
